name: Teikan no Eve Bethel
source:
“Welcome, Visitor. And... I am sorry.”

The story begins as Tachibana Kazuhito returns to the sunlit Advent City.

There, he lives an unforgettable life with his lively group of friends.

That is, until they are summoned to the Ruined World—a place where hopes and dreams take shape.

To protect themselves, Kazuhito and his friends must turn imagination into strength.

A battle of convictions against H.A.Z.E., a superpowered military force, begins.

And as all things melt into one, Eve Bethel awakens from her long slumber.
translation:
“欢迎，来访者。还有……对不起。”

故事从立花和人回到阳光明媚的Advent市开始。

在这里，他与一群活泼的朋友们，共度难以忘怀的日常。

直到众人被召唤至“废墟世界”——一个希望与梦想能够化为实体的地方。

为了保护自己，和人与朋友们必须将想象转化为力量。

一场与拥有超能力的军事组织H.A.Z.E.之间的信念之战，就此打响。

当万物融为一体时，Eve Bethel从漫长的沉睡中苏醒。
